coastal.title: Squamish man uses motion-activated zombie to scare bears away from garbage
coastal.description: More than 33 bears have been killed by conservation officers in B.C. this year, including two that entered stores through automatic sliding doors in Hope and Squamish. It's led to creative solutions to keep the hungry animals away from attractants.

prince-george.title: Record-breaking owl migration in northern B.C. leaves bird banders scrambling
prince-george.description: A boom in mice and voles may have helped produce an unusually large wave of young saw-whet owls near Mackenzie, north of Prince George.

northwest.title: Break-ins cause up to $60K in damage at Nisga’a cultural site near Terrace
northwest.description: The Gitlaxdax Nisga’a Terrace Society says two break-ins at its Schremp Island property caused an estimated $50,000 to $60,000 in theft and damage. The incidents have forced the society to pause cultural programming while it secures the property and works to restore operations.
